scientific.integrity: The defining filter-wise ASAM perturbation is specialized exactly to one filter and a two-dimensional strictly convex quadratic. The one-step ratio is obtained by direct expansion, and the condition-number separation is an analytic asymptotic consequence rather than a finite experiment.
limitations: One-step Euclidean nonexpansion result rather than a global orbit classification.
Two-dimensional deterministic positive quadratic with one filter block.
No momentum, stochastic gradients, weight decay, multiple blocks, or learning-rate schedule.
The balanced-gradient direction is a motivated witness, not a proved globally worst direction.

title: Filter-wise ASAM hides a squared-condition-number mixed-mode one-step barrier
